citations.method_rule: Do not assume the human-facing rendering is the agent-facing interface. Target the page's semantic structure directly rather than reproducing what a human reader sees.

citations.title: Beyond Pixels: Exploring DOM Downsampling for LLM-Based Web Agents
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Raw DOM is impractical at realistic page sizes, where deeply nested containers, styling hooks and decorative elements obscure semantic structure. Downsample to the semantic skeleton before extraction rather than parsing raw HTML.

citations.method_rule: Screenshots omit content that is occluded, unrendered or hidden behind interaction. Do not treat visual salience as a proxy for presence; confirm against a structural representation.

citations.title: Entity Resolution in Practice: Lessons from a Self-Serve Pipeline
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Do not take transitive closure over pairwise matches. One false positive chains records that share nothing into a single cluster, and the error compounds rather than averaging out. Require a verified merge step before joining clusters.

citations.title: Generalized Bayesian Record Linkage and Regression with Exact Error Propagation
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Carry linkage uncertainty into the downstream conclusion rather than collapsing matches to boolean edges. A graph built from hard edges reports a confidence it never earned.

citations.title: A Survey of Blocking and Filtering Techniques for Entity Resolution
citations.authors: see arXiv record; author list not verified in this dispatch
citations.method_rule: Block candidates on a cheap key before pairwise comparison, so comparison cost stays tractable and unrelated records are never compared in the first place.
